deviations: AC24 'buyer finance' vs 'nonfinance staff': one login per agency (no staff roles inside an agency), so the owner is the only finance viewer; suppliers and end clients cannot open the worksheet (own rows only).

AC23 budget: the assistant's per-agency daily budget is kept in process memory; on serverless each instance counts separately, so the effective cap is per instance per day, documented in docs/50. The timeout (20 s) and the no-key/invalid/injection fallbacks are enforced per request.

AC27 'expired invitations': R1 invitation links already expire (14 days) and expired holds are treated as absent; reminders are in-app only (no email adapter is wired for collaboration), so 'missing email provider' cannot break delivery.
AC28 direct-payment delay: the milestone row has no timestamp for the agency's direct confirmation, so direct confirmations are counted but their delay is not measured (shown as such).
Planner candidates come from discovery, roster and partners only; the assistant regroups and retitles packages and cannot add ids (unit test plants an id in the brief and asserts it is absent).
Templates are code constants (five production templates); agencies cannot yet save custom templates.
